GET /accounts/{account_id}/billing/spend.description: Returns every spend policy on the account that has not been deleted, including disabled ones. Results are sorted by `name`, then `id`. There is no pagination.

schema.description: Represents a Cloudflare resource identifier tag.

errors.description: Always empty on success.

action.description: The action taken when the threshold is reached. `notification` sends an email to `notification_email`. `usage_block` blocks further usage of the product until the end of the billing period. Raising the threshold above the current balance, disabling the policy, or deleting it lifts the block early.

current_state.description: Read-only state on list/get responses, evaluated from the latest owning projector snapshot at request time, independently of the API replica. Configuration enabled/version/ETag do not change when a cycle rolls over. Audit history remains unchanged. Missing during a rolling upgrade or on mutation responses; clients must treat missing state as unavailable. Balances are asynchronous estimates, not a synchronous usage read.

enforcement.description: Durable desired cap and delivery bookkeeping for this policy, or null if no owned effect exists. Separate from threshold evaluation: pending/leased/retry can lag the new billing period. Succeeded with equal generations means delivery completed, not an EWC readback.

evaluated_at.description: Evaluation time; not the timestamp of the latest usage event.

status.description: Threshold evaluation, not proof of an edge cap. No current active period yields no_current_period for enabled policies; failed aggregate reads yield unavailable for enabled policies. Disabled policies report disabled. threshold_cents.description: The spend threshold for the current billing period, in US cents.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. It starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update or delete. This value is also returned in `ETag`.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/billing/spend.description: Returns the policy's evaluation history, newest first. At most one entry is recorded per trigger (`approaching_limit` or `limit_reached`), policy version and billing period, so a policy update can record a new entry without any change in balance. Disabled policies still return their history; deleted policies return `404`. There is no pagination: use `limit` to set how many entries come back.

action.description: The action taken when the threshold is reached. `notification` sends an email to `notification_email`. `usage_block` blocks further usage of the product until the end of the billing period. Raising the threshold above the current balance, disabling the policy, or deleting it lifts the block early.

balance_cents.description: The account's balance for the product at evaluation time, in US cents.

billing_period_end.description: Exclusive end of the billing period that was evaluated.

billing_period_start.description: Inclusive start of the billing period that was evaluated.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of the trigger.
reason.example: balance reached or exceeded the configured threshold

source.description: What caused the evaluation. `kafka` means a balance update. `policy_revision` means a change to the policy.

threshold_cents.description: The policy threshold at evaluation time, in US cents.

trigger.description: The state the balance moved into. `approaching_limit` means the balance is at least 80% of the threshold (rounded up to a whole cent), but below the threshold. `limit_reached` means the balance reached or exceeded the threshold.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/billing/spen.description: Creates a spend policy. Each account can have only one enabled `usage_block` policy per product. A second one returns `409`. There is no limit on `notification` policies.

schema.description: Represents a Cloudflare resource identifier tag.

durable_objects_notification.summary: Email when Durable Objects spend reaches $1.00

schema.description: A spend policy as sent on create and on full replacement. Unknown fields and trailing JSON are rejected. Only the first 1 MiB of the body is read.

action.description: The action taken when the threshold is reached. `notification` sends an email to `notification_email`. `usage_block` blocks further usage of the product until the end of the billing period. Raising the threshold above the current balance, disabling the policy, or deleting it lifts the block early.

name.description: Display name of the policy. After surrounding whitespace is trimmed, it must be 1 to 200 bytes long. The value is stored as sent, untrimmed.

notification_email.description: Email address that receives notifications. Required when `action` is `notification`. When set, it must be a bare address (`user@example.com`); display-name forms such as `Name <user@example.com>` are rejected.

product_id.description: The product the policy applies to: `workers` or `durable_objects`. Each product's balance and policies are separate. Both products support `notification` and `usage_block` policies on create and update.

threshold_cents.description: The spend threshold for the current billing period, in US cents. Must be greater than zero.

ETag.description: The policy `version`, quoted, for use in `If-Match`.

schema.description: A successful response containing one spend policy.

errors.description: Always empty on success.

account_id.description: Internal numeric ID of the account that owns the policy. This is not the account tag used in the path.

action.description: The action taken when the threshold is reached. `notification` sends an email to `notification_email`. `usage_block` blocks further usage of the product until the end of the billing period. Raising the threshold above the current balance, disabling the policy, or deleting it lifts the block early.

current_state.description: Read-only state on list/get responses, evaluated from the latest owning projector snapshot at request time, independently of the API replica. Configuration enabled/version/ETag do not change when a cycle rolls over. Audit history remains unchanged. Missing during a rolling upgrade or on mutation responses; clients must treat missing state as unavailable. Balances are asynchronous estimates, not a synchronous usage read.

enforcement.description: Durable desired cap and delivery bookkeeping for this policy, or null if no owned effect exists. Separate from threshold evaluation: pending/leased/retry can lag the new billing period. Succeeded with equal generations means delivery completed, not an EWC readback.

evaluated_at.description: Evaluation time; not the timestamp of the latest usage event.

status.description: Threshold evaluation, not proof of an edge cap. No current active period yields no_current_period for enabled policies; failed aggregate reads yield unavailable for enabled policies. Disabled policies report disabled. Neither no_current_period nor unavailable implies a zero balance or below-limit state. Operators may disable current-state reads, in which case current_state is omitted.

id.description: The unique identifier of the spend policy.

notification_email.description: Email address that receives notifications. An empty string when none is set.

product_id.description: The product the policy applies to: `workers` or `durable_objects`. Each product's balance and policies are separate. Both products support `notification` and `usage_block` policies on create and update.

threshold_cents.description: The spend threshold for the current billing period, in US cents.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. It starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update or delete. This value is also returned in `ETag`.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/billing/spend.description: Replaces the whole spend policy. Every field is required, as on create; there are no partial updates and `PATCH` is not supported. The `If-Match` header must equal the policy's current `version`. On success, `version` goes up by one and the new value is returned in `ETag`.
